## Why

At PR229 head fc48d575d2f813e02718feb4c8b82855ae810a77, CI job122835122356 passed45source tests but failed the new combined case: ambient FFprobe was absent in the fake-provider job. Packaged CI was skipped; local installed tools hid the mistake.

## What Changes

- Keep mandatory combined actual-core source/package acceptance using configured fake backends, with a bounded owned PNG/WAV probe fixture.
- Retain explicit genuine mode and every independent FFmpeg decoding assertion; no availability-based selection or skip.
- Preserve common state/source/history/revision/reconnect/no-replay assertions and distinguish evidence by mode.

## Capabilities

### New Capabilities

None.

### Modified Capabilities

- `durable-production-requests`: hermetic combined acceptance with retained genuine proof.

## Impact

Private test helper, fixture, smoke call sites and regressions only; no breaking/public/runtime/schema/dependency/workflow/profile/timeout change.

## Non-goals

No PR233 or disposal/deletion/junction/crash/descendant work; no CI installs, relaxed checks, merge/deploy, force push, PR approval/readiness, issue closure, description update or comments. Preserve archives, pins and failed CI evidence.

## Approval

Pending exact-artifact reviewer approval before executable edits.

design.md.text:
## Context

The helper overrides configured fake tools with ambient names. Shared fake FFprobe reports1x1/100ms, unlike the real3x3 PNG/400ms WAV.

## Goals / Non-Goals

Repair test isolation and retain genuine proof. No production, lifecycle, dependency, workflow, profile or timeout changes.

## Decisions

1. Hermetic mode uses supplied fake FFmpeg. A private probe delegates version checks to supplied FFprobe and derives actual header facts from bounded ordinary owned PNG/WAV files; reject unknown/malformed/changed/out-of-root inputs. Keep shared fake backend verbatim.
2. Both modes retain all existing core/source/provenance/narration/history/admission/start/reconnect/old-job/stale-revision assertions. Hermetic output must match exact existing fake bytes/size; it is not pixel evidence.
3. Explicit genuine mode requires explicit genuine paths, retains the independent64x64 RGBA decoding assertion, and fails for missing tools without fallback/skip. Exercise source and assembled package in both modes with separate evidence.
4. Regress configured-tool and owned-input failures plus absence of ambient tools. Existing native/release gates remain unchanged.

## Risks / Migration

Bounds/header/hash checks prevent fabricated probe success. Explicit mode prevents evidence confusion. No persisted/public migration. Preserve fc48d575/failed CI; publish only a verified corrective PR229 descendant.

specs/durable-production-requests/spec.m.text:
## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Hermetic combined acceptance with retained genuine-media proof
Combined artwork/narration/durable source and package acceptance MUST use actual core and explicitly configured test backends in hermetic mode without ambient media tools, readiness skips or weakened common assertions. Probe facts MUST derive from bounded validated owned bytes. Explicit genuine mode MUST retain independent FFmpeg decoding and require explicit genuine tools. Evidence MUST distinguish modes; runtime, gates, profiles, timeouts and historical oracles SHALL remain unchanged.

#### Scenario: Hermetic source and package
- **WHEN** ambient media tools are absent and configured fake backends are supplied
- **THEN** the complete combined scenario passes, checking exact fake output and all common assertions without claiming pixels

#### Scenario: Explicit genuine source and package
- **WHEN** genuine mode is selected
- **THEN** explicit genuine tools independently decode the actual64x64 frame; missing tools fail without fallback/skip and common assertions remain

#### Scenario: Invalid configuration or fixture
- **WHEN** configured tools are absent or a probe input is unknown, malformed, changed or outside owned bounds/root
- **THEN** acceptance fails explicitly without ambient fallback or fabricated success
